title: CopperList
description: Plugin for servers with the seasons system. Improves the Whitelist and allows you to give games a pass for a limited number of seasons.
body:
🍂 CopperList - Smart Seasonal Access for Your Server
CopperList is a lightweight and elegant plugin designed specifically for private Minecraft servers with a seasonal progression system. It gives you flexible control over player access (whitelisting), allowing you to grant entry for just the current season or permanently.

This is the perfect solution for servers that sell seasonal passes or run regular wipes with player rotation!

✨ Main Features
Feature	Description
⏳ Flexible Access Control	Easily separate temporary players from permanent server residents.
🔄 Quick Season Wipes	End a season with a single command — the plugin automatically revokes access for single-season players.
🛡️ LuckPerms Support	Seamless integration with the most popular permission manager for effortless group and privilege management.
🚀 Simple & Lightweight	Zero bloat — the plugin has minimal impact on server performance and is highly intuitive to configure.
 
💻 Plugin Commands

/copperlist add <nick> type:one	
Grants the specified player access for exactly 1 current season.

/copperlist add <nick> type:all	
Grants the player access for all seasons (permanent).

![up](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3afbdeedeb58f42bfa411fd379e2ef9fd845ab34.gif)

/copperlist up <nick>	
Upgrades a player's status from a single season to permanent access.

![stop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e82f31de77af7ac7256e747ed496df06b5ddba6.gif)

/copperlist stop season	
Ends the current season (automatically revokes access for players with type:one).
 
⚙️ LuckPerms Compatibility
The plugin works perfectly in tandem with LuckPerms! You can easily set up command permissions for your staff and integrate the plugin with auto-donation web stores (for example, having the console automatically execute the /copperlist add command when a player buys a seasonal pass).
